sessions.phase_label: Franchise architecture and commercial scope definition
Detailed site specification, Seattle launch planning, and design alignment
Website implementation, previews, and design review
Functional review and correction of site, account, and domain associations

requirements.title: National Master Site Role
requirements.definition: The primary Smash Room website serves as the national, informational brand homepage rather than processing location bookings itself.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the master site's product role only; location selection and outbound routing are independently testable navigation behavior.

requirements.title: Location Selection and Routing
requirements.definition: The master site provides a location selector, menu, or equivalent controls that route visitors to the appropriate location website.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers selector and link behavior; homepage section composition, domain ownership, and the destination sites' booking functions remain separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Standalone Wix Sites for Locations
requirements.definition: Operational locations use separate Wix websites or accounts connected through the master brand site.
requirements.boundary_note: Captures the selected multi-site Wix architecture; the specific data and payout isolation outcomes are separate independently verifiable Requirements.

requirements.title: Correct Domain and Wix Profile Mapping
requirements.definition: Each website and domain is associated with the correct Wix profile or account, including the master domain resolving to the master site.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers persistent domain-to-site and site-to-profile configuration; it does not duplicate page content, location routing, or backend data separation.

requirements.title: Dedicated Location Experiences
requirements.definition: Each current location has its own identifiable visitor-facing page or site experience while remaining part of the shared Smash Room brand.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the existence and location-specific identity of current experiences; future extensibility and Seattle's temporary coming-soon state are separate.

requirements.title: Reusable Future Location Template
requirements.definition: The site structure supports adding future franchise locations without a redesign, using the Seattle location design as a reusable template.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers extensibility for future locations rather than the completion or content of any current location page.

requirements.title: Independent Location Business Data
requirements.definition: Each location independently controls and tracks its bookings, calendars, customers, analytics, memberships, gift cards, staff access, revenue, and reporting.
requirements.boundary_note: Groups the related non-payout isolation semantics of each location's backend account; payout separation follows a distinct Wix limitation and failure trajectory.

requirements.title: Independent Location Payments and Payouts
requirements.definition: Each location has independent payment processing and payout handling rather than sharing one payout account.
requirements.boundary_note: Kept separate because Wix could isolate bookings and reporting while failing to support separate payouts, demonstrating an independent acceptance condition.

requirements.title: Location Booking System
requirements.definition: Location websites provide Wix booking functionality and editable booking pages, while the master site delegates bookings to those location websites.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers booking capability and its placement on location sites; separate booking data ownership and package catalog content are different Requirements.

requirements.title: Location Packages and Prices
requirements.definition: Location experiences include the required package offerings and prices, with the established packages and pricing retained when the shared format is reused.
requirements.boundary_note: Packages and prices are independently visible content and can be absent even when booking software exists, so they are not an attribute of booking installation.

requirements.title: Smash Room Brand Identity
requirements.definition: The master and location experiences use the client's Smash Room logos, branding, and established black, purple, and white color identity consistently.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers brand assets and colors; competitor-inspired layout and responsive behavior can change or fail independently.

requirements.title: Competitor-Referenced Visual Design
requirements.definition: The new site uses the approved competitor websites as references for a clean, modern layout, structure, spacing, imagery scale, and straightforward navigation while remaining a new design.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers visual and structural direction rather than company branding, required page content, or mobile responsiveness.

requirements.title: Mobile-Friendly Site Experience
requirements.definition: The website provides a mobile-friendly responsive experience.
requirements.boundary_note: Responsiveness has its own device-specific acceptance criterion and is not merely an attribute of the chosen visual reference.

requirements.title: Master Homepage Section Composition
requirements.definition: The master homepage presents the specified offerings and informational sections, including activity categories, events, reviews, FAQ, and contact content.
requirements.boundary_note: Section membership is treated as one homepage composition mechanism; selector routing and activity-specific image semantics are independently testable.

requirements.title: Activity-Specific Imagery
requirements.definition: Activity content uses imagery that accurately represents the activity, including paint-participant imagery for Splatter Room and targets or axe throwers for Axe Throwing.
requirements.boundary_note: The activity-to-image mapping can be corrected without changing homepage sections, branding, or the overall design reference.

requirements.title: Seattle Coming-Soon Landing Page
requirements.definition: Before opening, Seattle is presented through a promotional coming-soon page with the specified activity and information sections, opening-soon messaging, gallery, contact information, and launch-ready design.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers Seattle's temporary pre-opening presentation and readiness for later photo and booking activation; VIP data capture is a separate functional behavior.

requirements.title: Seattle VIP Email Signup
requirements.definition: The Seattle launch page provides a Join VIP List action that captures prospective customer email signups.
requirements.boundary_note: Email capture has its own input and persistence behavior and can fail independently of the surrounding coming-soon page content.

requirements.title: Reuse of Existing Site Content and Media
requirements.definition: The new website uses relevant textual content and images from the existing Bay Area website as source material while applying the new design.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers one-time content and media reuse; it excludes the competitor-derived visual design and the separately maintained package and booking behaviors.

requirements.title: Bay Area SEO-Preserving Migration
requirements.definition: The transition to the new master site minimizes damage to Bay Area search rankings by preserving important SEO elements, keeping the existing site available during transition, and connecting it appropriately to the master site.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers migration-specific ranking preservation; permanent domain/profile correctness and ordinary location routing are separate Requirements.

unresolved_candidates.description: Austin is listed as a possible future location in the formal specification but later appears as an existing Wix page or profile. The evidence does not safely establish Austin as a current customer-facing location Requirement rather than a mislabeled account.

The report that packages and booking software are missing does not unambiguously identify which location website was inspected. The underlying Requirements are clear, but execution routing will require local adjudication.
